title: DOH monitors monkey‑linked malaria cases in Northern Palawan

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Department of Health in Mimaropa is monitoring cases of malaria caused by a monkey‑borne parasite in northern Palawan, particularly in the municipalities of Roxas and San Vicente. Malaria attributed to the parasite Plasmodium knowlesi has been confirmed after an assessment conducted together with experts from the World Health Organization
